v1.15.0e (14 March 2024) |feed_title = 🔧 Quality of Life 🔧 |previous_update = [[v1.14.0|Trapper Update]] |next_update = [[v1.16.0|The Hunt Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.15.0''' is the sixty-seventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 8th of March 2024. This update brought in various quality of life changes, small visual differences and multiple fixes. This update encompassed six updates, the main v1.15.0 update (released 8 March 2024) and five minor updates, the v1.15.0a (released 9 March 2024), the v1.15.0b (released 11 March 2024), v1.15.0c (released 11 March 2024), v1.15.0d update (released 13 March 2024) and v1.15.0e update (released 14 March 2024). ==Additions== *[[XP Boost]] **Replaced 50% {{Exp|}} Fridays to Sundays. *[[VIP Boost]] **Replaced the old 25% VIP gamepass boost. :In '''v1.15.0b''' *Added dark blue empty portal in the lobby with a countdown **Countdown counts down until March 15th at 17:00 UTC :In '''v1.15.0d''' *[[Rewards#Badges|Suspicious...]] Badge Reward ==Removals== *50% {{Exp|}} from 0:00 UTC on Fridays to 24:00 UTC on Sundays **Replaced by the [[XP Boost]]. ==Changes & Bugfixes== *VIP gamepass now applies the [[VIP Boost]] modifier to increase the {{Exp|}} by 25%. *Updated modifiers UI. **Rewards increase moved to be under the icon instead of in the description. *Updated [[Quests]] UI. *Adjusted VFX for impact explosions. *Changed [[Tutorial]] music. *Added more developer statues to the lobby. *Towers can no longer be placed after losing. *[[Trapper]] no longer makes text appears on the screen with information about a trap being equipped. *Fixed [[Engineer]] sentries dealing high amounts of damage when they collide with an enemy while its shield is active. *Fixed [[Trapper]] breaking when there is no path to place traps in its range. *Fixed [[Quests#Kill ENEMY!|Kill ENEMY!]] quest having [[Imposter]] and ''Arrow'' as enemies that can be chosen for it. *Fixed [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode not rewarding the badge for triumphing it. *Fixed [[Tutorial]] not rewarding the badge for triumphing if it was played through the settings. *Fixed [[Tutorial]] rewarding the badge when it was skipped. *Fixed [[Tutorial]] music not playing. *Fixed the [[DJ Booth]] custom music gamepass selling the VIP gamepass instead of the [[DJ Booth]] gamepass. :In '''v1.15.0a''' *Fixed scaling for the modifier UI on mobile. **Prevents overlapping with the tower hot bar in mobile devices. :In '''v1.15.0b''' *Upgrade box is no longer covered up by modifiers as modifiers now appear under it, also fixing an issue where modifiers covered up the sell button. :In '''v1.15.0c''' *Fixed every match breaking, making the game unplayable. :In '''v1.15.0d''' *[[Imposter]] now gives a badge upon death. :In '''v1.15.0e''' *Added The Hunt advertisement in the intermission lobby ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.14Thumb.png CBRThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} CommanderArtIcon.png V1.15Icon2.png V1.15Icon3.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.15.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|TutorialRender.png|🔧 Quality of Life 🔧}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|⬆️ Double XP Weekend!}} *Double XP starts every Friday and ends on Sunday! *You should see the double XP icon on the modifiers when it's active! {{UpdateH3|🛠️ Changes:}} *New [[Modifiers]] UI *Added in more developer statues *Adjusted VFX for the impact explosion *Fixed [[Easy Mode|easy mode]] badge awarding *Fixed [[medic]] healing behavior *Added new [[tutorial]] music *Fixed [[Quests#Kill ENEMY!|enemy quest]] giving out impossible enemies to kill *Fixed [[Trapper]] tower when there's no path to place a trap on *Fixed skipping the [[tutorial]] still awarding the [[tutorial]] badge *Fixed max level [[War Machine Sentry|sentries]] dealing contact damage when their shield is up *Fixed the Custom Music gamepass showing the wrong information in the lobby {{UpdateH3|🔥 Next Week 🔥}} *Huge update? 🤔 *...keep an eye on our socials for more info! 📣 }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.15.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
